--- /linux/drivers/hid/hid-core.c
+++ /linux/drivers/hid/hid-core.c
@@ -2001 +2001,6 @@
-	buf = kzalloc(len + 7, GFP_KERNEL);
+	/*
+	 * Allocate enough space for the report.
+	 * HID_MAX_BUFFER_SIZE padding is added because some drivers/layers
+	 * might access slightly beyond len or race conditions might persist.
+	 */
+	buf = kzalloc(len + HID_MAX_BUFFER_SIZE, GFP_KERNEL);

--- /linux/drivers/hid/hid-core.c
+++ /linux/drivers/hid/hid-core.c
@@ -2001,6 +2001,4 @@
-	/*
-	 * Allocate enough space for the report.
-	 * HID_MAX_BUFFER_SIZE padding is added because some drivers/layers
-	 * might access slightly beyond len or race conditions might persist.
-	 */
-	buf = kzalloc(len + HID_MAX_BUFFER_SIZE, GFP_KERNEL);
+	if (len > 32768)
+		len = 32768;
+
+	buf = kzalloc(65536, GFP_KERNEL);
